title: CastWorld: Benchmarking Context-Aware Agentic Time Series Forecasting Beyond Predictive Accuracy
abstract: arXiv:2611.15262v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic time series forecasting extends conventional approaches beyond one-shot numerical prediction toward autonomous, context-aware interaction. However, existing benchmarks offer limited integrated support for diverse contextual information, forecasting-specific adaptive interactions, and systematic evaluation of forecasting agents. In this paper, we introduce CastWorld, an agentic benchmark for context-aware time series forecasting. First, its context-rich dataset suite spans 8 domains and 25 real-world datasets, covering external variables, events, and historical cases under a unified context specification. Second, a lightweight, modular forecasting-native harness provides 49 core tools and a state-adaptive loop that tracks forecast versions and enables iterative evidence gathering and forecast revision. Intermediate forecasts can expose information gaps, while newly acquired evidence guides subsequent revisions and final version

translated_title: CastWorld：超越预测精度的上下文感知智能体时间序列预测基准测试
translated_abstract: 智能体时间序列预测将传统方法从一次性数值预测扩展到自主的、上下文感知的交互。然而，现有的基准测试在多样化上下文信息、预测特定的自适应交互以及预测智能体的系统化评估方面所提供的集成支持较为有限。本文提出了CastWorld，一个面向上下文感知时间序列预测的智能体基准测试。首先，其丰富的上下文数据集套件涵盖8个领域和25个真实世界数据集，在统一的上下文规范下包含外部变量、事件和历史案例。其次，一个轻量级、模块化的预测原生框架提供了49个核心工具和一个状态自适应循环，该循环跟踪预测版本，支持迭代式的证据收集和预测修订。中间预测可以暴露信息缺口，而新获取的证据则指导后续的修订和最终版本的生成。
tldr: CastWorld是一个面向上下文感知智能体时间序列预测的基准测试，提供了涵盖8个领域25个真实数据集的丰富上下文数据套件，以及包含49个核心工具和状态自适应循环的预测原生框架，实现了对预测智能体超越单纯预测精度的系统化评估。
en_tdlr: CastWorld is a benchmark for context-aware agentic time series forecasting, featuring a context-rich dataset suite spanning 8 domains and 25 real-world datasets, together with a lightweight forecasting-native harness offering 49 core tools and a state-adaptive loop for systematic evaluation beyond predictive accuracy.
